## Batch 59 complete

Authored the three planned A items, the B counterexample, and the local Hermite-decay prerequisite. The A/B pages and manifest are complete; the manifest records dependency levels 0 for three suppliers and 1 for the Gaussian theorem and counterexample. All five items have current `ready` Step 1 records.

The design’s A/B metadata matches `plan-spec.json`; its item arrays are empty, so the detailed design supplied the planned inventory. The Hermite lemma is an additional, fully proved A-page prerequisite.

All nine passed fetch verification on the first attempt. Precheck passed for all five items; proof layout found 0 defects across 26 steps; proof contracts passed for 5/5 items; scoped dependency, content-policy, render, coverage, manifest, and source-fetch checks passed. The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-59.notes.md) record the supplier review and results.

The assigned dependency graph is clean. The run-wide item-level check still reports 190 empty inventories in other batches, and the shared batch-dependency-levels input hash is stale. Both shared run-level files were left for the owner’s drained construction join.
